property_summary: A call to setL1BlockValues must revert unless the caller is the depositor account
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.sender == DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT, "L1Block: only the depositor account can set L1 block values");` with `require(true, "L1Block: only the depositor account can set L1 block values");`, effectively removing the onlyDepositor restriction so any caller can modify timestamp.
